intendedUse: Normalize a current North Macedonia four-digit postal designator, retrieve a rights-cleared real postcode Polygon or MultiPolygon through the AGID API, fit the map and render a translucent area with a clear outline and complete provenance.
recordGrain: one current North Macedonia ordinary or exception postal assignment and its truthful postal geometry; locality, facility, administrative, address, cadastral and AGID containment authorities remain separate

m2Definition.definition: A current complete rights-cleared Pošta na Severna Makedonija four-digit postcode assignment and exception denominator, including localities, delivery offices, PO boxes, poste restante, organizations and other special or non-geographic endpoints, and real postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon surfaces are pinned by edition or retrieval basis, effective date, terms, byte length, SHA-256, coverage and exceptions, published as an approved immutable artifact, and loaded through the real MK API/app so a normalized NNNN search fits and renders a translucent area with a clear outline, selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual classification, source, reference date and confidence. Locality rows, delivery offices, facility points, municipalities, branches, address or cadastral units, buffers, hulls, Voronoi or raster cells and synthetic fixtures never satisfy M2 by themselves. A derived surface is eligible only from an expressly authorized complete current postal-membership denominator with reproducible lineage, limitations and noncanonical status preserved.

officialObservations.finding: The current public table is a locality/postcode/delivery-office/municipality/branch assignment reference. It supplies no postcode area and no documented complete exception denominator.
The current public locator supplies finite latitude/longitude facility markers. It is not a postal-area product.
The two public official products have different grains and code sets. No versioned ordinary-plus-exception denominator or reconciliation was found.
The operator describes a postal network of more than 300 units, consistent with the locator's facility grain but not evidence of postcode perimeters.
Privacy and public-information contact pages exist, but no dataset-specific bulk extraction, derivation, redistribution or public-serving grant was established. No contact was made.
Both official portals timed out during the run. Official web search exposed no postcode-area release. This is availability evidence only and does not prove nonexistence.

reproducibility.method: Select the largest operator HTML table, retain five-cell rows with an exact four-digit second cell, normalize Unicode/text and count unique dimensions; parse the public locator JSON, validate finite coordinates, extract rendered four-digit values, count geometry tokens and reconcile code sets.

dataQuality.risk: Current operator evidence is locality membership and facility Point evidence only. The code sets do not reconcile to a documented complete denominator, no dataset-specific public-serving grant was established, and no real postcode surface exists.

browserReview.reason: No official or rights-cleared derived real MK postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon artifact exists to exercise. Browser rendering was not staged with locality rows, facility points, administrative context or synthetic proxy data.

reportPresentation.reason: An exact audit table communicates the zero-area and set-reconciliation result more accurately than a chart.

blockerSummary: The current official addressing table has 1,831 locality rows and 230 four-digit codes but zero postcode polygons. The current locator has 331 valid facility Points, 326 rendered codes and zero polygons; only 218 codes overlap. Neither product documents a complete ordinary-plus-exception denominator. No dataset-specific public-serving grant or real postcode surface was established, and Government open-data/NSDI portals timed out. A real MK area artifact cannot be served or rendered without inventing geometry.
unblockConditions: Obtain an unrestricted current authoritative North Macedonia postcode-boundary release, or an expressly authorized complete current postal-membership denominator covering four-digit ordinary codes and every exception class with an approved reproducible derivation basis.
Pin edition or retrieval basis, effective date, dataset-specific terms, attribution, byte length, SHA-256, code classes, coverage and exceptions.

Validate Polygon/MultiPolygon closure, coordinate range, topology, country scope, completeness and non-areal exceptions without substituting locality rows, facility points, municipalities, branches, address/cadastral units, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells or synthetic fixtures.
Publish an approved immutable artifact and pass real MK normalization, loader, API, fit, translucent fill, outline, provenance, clear and re-search verification.
